name: Warranty and Registration Agent
headline: Know what a repair is covered for before the wrench comes out
pitch: Give equipment dealers one conversation for warranty coverage, claim pre-checks, serial checks, registration drafts and extended-coverage offers, while claims, registrations and sales stay with the people authorized to submit them.
why_try: The demo walks a dealer service manager from a coverage overview to a covered repair, an expired unit, a clean registration draft and a short list of extension offers, each answer computed from the same fixed snapshot.
customer_challenge: Dealers look up coverage across separate warranty, catalog and registration screens, miss registration windows on newly sold units, file claims that are rejected for lapsed or parts-only coverage, and let extension opportunities expire unnoticed.
microsoft_ai_story: Copilot Studio gives dealers a Teams or Microsoft 365 Copilot front door; approved ERP warranty, product catalog and registration services can be bound with dealer-scoped identity, least-privilege connections and audit, while every claim, registration and offer stays a human-submitted draft.
business_value: Fewer rejected warranty claims because coverage is checked before the repair.
No sold unit misses its registration window.
Extended-coverage offers reach customers before coverage ends.
business_flow: Approved ERP warranty module and product catalog

capabilities.name: Coverage overview
capabilities.purpose: Use when a dealer asks how their warranty coverage looks overall: active, expiring, expired and awaiting registration.

capabilities.name: Claim pre-check
capabilities.purpose: Use when a dealer asks whether a repair on a specific serial is covered; returns a pre-check, never files a claim.

capabilities.name: Unit warranty record
capabilities.purpose: Use when someone asks for the full warranty record or claim history of one serial.

capabilities.name: Serial check
capabilities.purpose: Use when a dealer wants to check a serial (format, catalog, duplicate) before registering a sold unit.

capabilities.name: Registration draft
capabilities.purpose: Use when a dealer asks to prepare or draft a product registration; the draft stays Not Submitted.

capabilities.name: Extended-coverage offers
capabilities.purpose: Use when a dealer asks which units to offer extended coverage to; returns offer drafts, never sends or sells.

prompts.label: Dealer Service Manager: Claim pre-check
prompts.prompt: A customer brought in welding station WS-25-4471 with a failed wire feeder. Is the repair covered?

recorded_answer.prompt: A customer brought in welding station WS-25-4471 with a failed wire feeder. Is the repair covered?
recorded_answer.answer:
Good news — WS-25-4471 is pre-check eligible: it's registered, warranty is active with 326 days remaining, and coverage includes both parts and labor. Note it has 1 prior claim on record.

This is a pre-check only, not a filed claim. Next step: have the Northwind warranty desk review and formally approve it, with the failure description, photos, and labor hours for the wire feeder issue.
